meta.scope: metadata-only: column presence, null counts, design-metadata value counts, entity-key counts, QC-flag counts, identity joins; no expression read, no response statistics, no model fitting

functional_endpoint_check.note: obs columns are single-cell transcriptome design/QC metadata; var columns are gene-level summary metadata (no response endpoint); obsm/layers/uns are empty

mixed_time_labels.note: cells carry a comma-joined time label; a single time cannot be assigned from metadata, so these cells cannot enter a two-snapshot 6h-vs-24h comparison

census_replay.column_note: census has columns time/perturbation/cell_line/channel/cells only: no dose, batch, culture or functional-endpoint columns

independent_functional_endpoint.evidence: no viability/apoptosis/GR/IC50/response-like column in obs or var; obsm/layers empty; uns empty; var columns are gene-level summary metadata
independent_functional_endpoint.consequence: decision-level evaluation (does dynamic information change a concrete drug decision) cannot be run on this asset alone; an external functional readout matched to the same perturbations/cell lines is required

batch_proxies.note: channel/hash_tag are multiplexing metadata (mixed numeric/letter values, sparse); they do not certify independent cultures, batches, or matched experimental runs between 6h and 24h

channel_availability.note: channel is missing for all exact-6h cells and for the 4-drug/control 24h cells; it is populated only for some 24h-only dose arms -> it cannot serve as a matched batch proxy for the 6h-vs-24h comparison

field_conflicts.perturbation_says: Trametinib for all rows (incl. hash labels DMSO_*/Untreated_*)
field_conflicts.dose_placeholder: dose_value=0.1 uM for all rows incl. DMSO labels

hashed_timecourse_arm.note: per-cell time/treatment is recoverable from hash_assignment for single-tag cells only; hash calls are not re-derived here; combo/multiplet cells are excluded; batch/run metadata absent; samples are destructive snapshots, not trajectories

prism_metadata_check.note: metadata columns only (drug names/doses, DepMap IDs); response matrices not opened

targets: PSMA1, PSMA2, PSMA3, PSMA4, PSMA5, PSMA6, PSMA7, PSMA8, PSMB1, PSMB10, PSMB11, PSMB2, PSMB3, PSMB4, PSMB5, PSMB6, PSMB7, PSMB8, PSMB9, PSMD1, PSMD2, RELA

prior_derived_assets_listing_only.note: listing only; npz caches from a prior study (kinetic_horizon_20261010) appear to hold derived pseudobulk/state/PRISM-matched arrays. Provenance, splits and response values were NOT audited and NOT read in this metadata-only qualification; they cannot be treated as certified functional endpoints.

limitations: Metadata-only: no expression matrix was read; no response statistics computed.
h5ad obs has no explicit batch/plate/donor/run column; channel/hash_tag are multiplexing proxies only, and channel is missing for all exact-6h and 4-drug 24h cells.
The 285 common keys are (perturbation, cell_line) at exact time labels '6' and '24'; channel or dose added to the key changes counts (see key_definition_sensitivity).

The comma time labels are aggregation artifacts: the Trametinib arm's per-cell time/treatment is recoverable from hash_assignment for single-tag cells (3/6/12/24/48 h + DMSO controls), but the hash calls are not re-derived here and 2,339 combo + 136 unresolved cells are excluded.
Dose metadata is a single placeholder value per arm (0.0 for BRD3379/control, 0.1 for Trametinib, 2.5 for Bortezomib/Idasanutlin; the hashed arm records 0.1 even for DMSO labels) -> not certified.
No independent functional endpoint (viability/apoptosis) is present in the h5ad, so decision-level questions cannot be evaluated on this asset alone.
Cells at different time points are separate populations (destructive snapshots); no cell-level trajectory or lineage link exists in the asset.
Prior derived caches (kinetic_horizon_20261010 npz) are listed only; provenance/splits/response values were not audited and are not used here.
